- Alternate considerations per DDx and transcript: viral upper respiratory infection/acute bronchitis (new cough since yesterday) and anxiety-related dyspnea/palpitations (patient reports feeling very stressed). These are less likely given abrupt onset and postpartum VTE risk.
- No objective vitals or exam findings available beyond telehealth pulse estimate. No labs/imaging obtained in this encounter.
- Plan from transcript: Immediate hospital assessment advised; options discussed (ambulance vs self-transport). Patient chose self-transport. Advised to avoid codeine for now. Education provided on concern for clots and potential treatment if confirmed.

Management Plan
- Immediate action: Patient to proceed promptly to hospital/ED for evaluation of possible pulmonary embolism; take necessary items for baby. Avoid codeine until assessed.
- Safety: Discussed urgency and rationale; patient agreed to go. No additional home management provided.
